user_saw: On iOS, fractional-second timestamps caused calendar and reminder creation to fail and calendar and motion queries to silently use default date ranges.
summary: The fix routes iOS calendar, reminder, and motion timestamp inputs through a shared parser that accepts ISO 8601 timestamps with or without fractional seconds.
reasoning: All three services already used the default ISO8601DateFormatter for these inputs in the oldest readable checkout snapshot. The full-history path search stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify whether that parser shipped with the commands or replaced an earlier parser that accepted fractional seconds.
